patthana18.9:1.1: hetuṃ saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na saraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na hetuṃ saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na saraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuṃ saraṇañca na hetuṃ araṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na saraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana18.9:2.1: na hetuṃ araṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na hetuṃ araṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na hetuṃ araṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na araṇo ca na na hetu na araṇo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
